login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Log in to upload your CV or manage your profile.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter your email and we’ll send you a link to choose a new password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Open the link from your reset email, then enter your new password below.

messages.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account. Then come back and log in.

messages.passwordUpdated: Your password has been updated. Log in with your new password.
messages.confirmed: Your email is confirmed. You can now log in.

errors.weakPassword: Choose a stronger password with at least 8 characters. Follow any additional password rules set by the platform.
errors.passwordMismatch: Your passwords don’t match. Enter the same password in both fields.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email before logging in. Check your inbox and spam folder for the confirmation email.
errors.emailUsed: This email is already in use. Log in or reset your password.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a little before trying again.
errors.invalidLink: This link is missing, expired or already used. Request a new reset link, or try logging in if you’ve already confirmed your email.
errors.wrongRole: This login is for candidates. Please use the company or administrator login for your account.
errors.unavailable: We couldn’t connect to the account service. Please try again shortly.
errors.failed: We couldn’t complete your request. Please try again.

styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.intro: Every shared component in the club style. Copy from here instead of rewriting.
styleguide.bodySample: Body text: candidates upload a CV, the AI fills in their profile.
styleguide.cardDescription: A short description under the title.
styleguide.dialogDescription: Use a dialog for a short question that needs an answer.
styleguide.layoutBody: SiteHeader and SiteFooter sit in app/layout.tsx, so they appear on every page. Wrap page content in PageContainer.

landing.eyebrow: Pristini JE job fair · Wednesday 11 November 2026
landing.title: Your CV, ready for recruiters in minutes
landing.subtitle: Upload your CV, our AI fills in your profile, you check it and get a QR code to show at the fair.

candidate.title: I'm a candidate
candidate.text: Looking for a PFE, an internship or a job? Create your profile from your CV.

company.title: I'm a company
company.text: Search the candidates' profiles and scan their QR codes at the fair. The club sends you your login.

steps.title: Upload your CV
steps.text: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB. A photo from your phone works too.

steps.title: Check your profile
steps.text: Our AI fills it in for you. Fix anything it missed, then approve it. Nothing is shown to recruiters before you do.

steps.title: Show your QR code
steps.text: At the fair, recruiters scan it and open your profile. Your CV file is deleted after reading.

processing.title: We are reading your CV
processing.queued: Your CV is in the queue.
processing.queuedHint: Our AI reads one CV at a time. Keep this page open, it updates by itself.
processing.processing: Our AI is reading your CV…
processing.processingHint: This usually takes less than a minute.
processing.doneHint: Taking you to your profile so you can check it…
processing.failedDefault: Something went wrong while reading your CV. Please try again.
processing.slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can keep waiting: your place is kept.
processing.notFound: We can't find this CV. It may belong to another account.
processing.notLoggedIn: Log in with your candidate account to follow your CV.
